benchmarks.name: ZTTS1-Eval Clean (FLEURS-R) · 9-language mean WER
benchmarks.setup: ZTTS1-Eval Clean: 500 FLEURS-R read-speech utterances per language; zero-shot cloning where supported, preset voices otherwise. Qwen3-ASR scorer. Unweighted mean over en, zh, de, es, fr, it, ja, ko, ru (hard_en/hard_zh excluded).
caveats: Preset-voice systems (ElevenLabs v3, Gemini) do not clone the prompt speaker.

benchmarks.name: ZTTS1-Eval Clean (FLEURS-R) · 9-language mean MSR-UTMOS
benchmarks.setup: Same generations as ztts1-clean-ml9-wer; MSR-UTMOS (utmos22_strong) automatic naturalness prediction, unweighted mean over the nine languages.
benchmarks.display_unit: predicted MOS / 5; not human MOS, not accuracy
caveats: Automatic MOS predictor trained mainly on English; multilingual scores are indicative.

benchmarks.name: ZTTS1-Eval in-the-wild · 10-language mean WER
benchmarks.setup: ZTTS1-Eval in-the-wild set: spontaneous VoxBlink2 prompts (1,618 utterances, 17 languages). Qwen3-ASR scorer. Unweighted mean over the 10 languages every compared system supports: en, zh, de, es, fr, it, ja, ko, pt, ru. No prompt audio imported.
caveats: Preset-voice systems do not clone the noisy prompt speaker; they read with a clean built-in voice.

benchmarks.name: ZTTS1-Eval in-the-wild · 10-language mean MSR-UTMOS
benchmarks.setup: Same generations as ztts1-itw-10lang-wer; MSR-UTMOS mean over the same 10 languages.
benchmarks.display_unit: predicted MOS / 5; not human MOS, not accuracy

benchmarks.name: LEMAS multilingual TTS eval · 9-language mean WER
benchmarks.setup: LEMAS-Dataset evaluation set, 500 utterances per language (3-15 s, alignment score > 0.9), zero-shot cloning; Paraformer-zh for Chinese, Whisper-large-v3 otherwise (Seed-TTS protocol). Mean over de,en,es,fr,id,it,pt,ru,zh as printed for OpenAudio-S1-Mini (vi excluded, no value).
caveats: Only one catalogued system; raw evidence, not a calibrated comparison.

benchmarks.name: Granite 5.0 report · Open ASR public 7-set mean WER
benchmarks.setup: IBM's own evaluation in arXiv:2609.20104v1 Table 3 on the public components of the Open ASR leaderboard: AMI, Earnings22, Gigaspeech, LibriSpeech clean, LibriSpeech other, SPGISpeech, VoxPopuli (7 sets, TED-LIUM absent). AVG is the unweighted mean of the seven per-set WERs. Report text states Table 5/6 used the 20 May 2026 leaderboard version; Table 3 set version assumed the same public components. Greedy CTC decoding. Not the 8-set March-2026 Open ASR CSV mix (open-asr-wer) and not the leaderboard's private Voice Arena set.
caveats: Lab self-report; single-model series in this source.
Table 3 row 'Robust fine tuning' is the final of three training stages described for the released model; the table does not print the Hugging Face revision.
Do not merge with open-asr-wer: different set mix (no TED-LIUM) and different evaluator.

benchmarks.name: Seed-TTS test-en · Whisper large-v3 WER
benchmarks.setup: Zero-shot voice cloning on standard Seed-TTS-Eval test-en. Whisper-large-v3 transcripts. Different papers/runs retain individual configurations and provenance; no cross-paper remeasurement implied.

benchmarks.name: Seed-TTS test-en · speaker similarity (WavLM-large SV)
benchmarks.setup: Zero-shot voice cloning on the standard Seed-TTS-Eval test-en set (1,088 Common Voice samples). Cosine similarity between WavLM-large speaker-verification embeddings (UniSpeech, as in seed-tts-eval) of the generated speech and the original target speech (SIM-o) or the prompt, as each paper states (recorded per result). Each paper runs its own generations; per-source calibration keeps runs separate.
benchmarks.score_unit: raw cosine similarity (0-1 in practice); percentages divided by 100
caveats: Voice similarity, not quality or accuracy.
Papers differ in inference settings, seeds and resampling; values from different papers are not pooled.

benchmarks.name: Seed-TTS test-zh · Paraformer CER
benchmarks.setup: Zero-shot voice cloning on standard Seed-TTS-Eval test-zh. Paraformer Chinese transcripts. Papers label the compatibility column WER, but Chinese metric uses character error rate.

benchmarks.name: Seed-TTS test-zh · speaker similarity (WavLM-large SV)
benchmarks.setup: Zero-shot voice cloning on the standard Seed-TTS-Eval test-zh set (2,020 DiDiSpeech samples). Cosine similarity of WavLM-large speaker-verification embeddings (seed-tts-eval model) between generated speech and the original target (SIM-o) or prompt, as each paper states.
benchmarks.score_unit: raw cosine similarity; percentages divided by 100
caveats: Voice similarity, not quality or accuracy.
Papers differ in inference settings; values from different papers are not pooled.

benchmarks.name: StyleTTS-ZS LibriSpeech-40 listening test · naturalness MOS
benchmarks.setup: 40 LibriSpeech test-clean sentences with 3-s reference prompts (the VALL-E / NaturalSpeech 2 / FlashSpeech prompt set); each system rated by 10 US native-English MTurk raters on 1-5 in 0.5 steps, systems presented side by side with hidden labels (MUSHRA-like). Public LibriTTS-trained checkpoints.
caveats: Run by the StyleTTS 2 / StyleTTS-ZS authors (their StyleTTS-ZS rows not imported).

benchmarks.name: StyleTTS-ZS LibriSpeech-40 listening test · speaker-similarity MOS
benchmarks.setup: Same listening test as stylettszs-librispeech40-mos-n; similarity to the prompt speaker, 1-5 in 0.5 steps.

benchmarks.name: StyleTTS-ZS LibriSpeech-40 · HuBERT-large WER
benchmarks.setup: WER of the same 40 generated LibriSpeech test-clean sentences, transcribed with facebook/hubert-large-ls960-ft.

benchmarks.name: VoiceCraft zero-shot TTS set (LibriTTS + YouTube, 250) · Whisper medium.en WER
benchmarks.setup: 250 prompt-transcript pairs, half LibriTTS and half GigaSpeech YouTube test; ~3-s prompts cut at word boundaries, targets 8-40 words from another utterance of the same speaker. WER by Whisper medium.en.
caveats: VoiceCraft generates 5 samples and keeps the shortest (its own row only).

benchmarks.name: VoiceCraft zero-shot TTS set (250) · speaker similarity (WavLM-TDCNN)
benchmarks.setup: Same 250 generations; SIM from WavLM-TDCNN speaker embeddings.

benchmarks.name: VoiceCraft zero-shot TTS listening test (80) · naturalness MOS
benchmarks.setup: 80 utterances (40 LibriTTS, 40 YouTube) sampled from the 250-pair set; 10 MTurk ratings (US residents) per utterance on a 5-point Likert scale; Total column.
caveats: Ground truth scores 4.48; YouTube ground truth rated above LibriTTS.
